purpose: Follow-up to the coordinator review: ten findings, each fixed with the smallest change; only the tests covering the edited files were run.
mode: package (CI build-and-test catalog properties), Release, -warnaserror, -m:1, MinVerVersionOverride=1.0.0; same property set as verification.json

fixes.live-test-assertions: every captured launcher must have a DCP-reported exit code of 143; once a stop is reached, quiescence must have been observed and be within 30 s
fixes.live-test-descendant-walk: per-task and per-child IOException guards (ENOENT/ESRCH) skip only the exited entry and keep walking its siblings
fixes.live-test-failure-observer: every exception from BeginStop is caught and recorded as startup.observerFailure, so the fixture always runs its partial-startup teardown
fixes.live-test-skipped-launchers: each modeled *-dapr-cli with no state, pid, start identity or launcher cmdline is recorded in skippedLaunchers with its reason; any skip fails the test when the topology was available
fixes.live-test-evidence-on-every-path: observers are cancelled and the timing JSON written in a finally, before awaiting a still-running disposal; a run failure is recorded as runFailure
fixes.live-test-daprd-ordering: daprdOutlivedLauncher is null unless every exit was observed, false when the launcher outlived daprd, true only when a daprd exited later; exitSamplingResolutionMs is 10
fixes.admin-organization-rows: OrganizationEditRoute_RendererInteractivity_GatesFieldsetsSaveAndCancel Static/Server rows render the Organization details fieldset and assert the gate and a Static submit issuing no update
fixes.consumer-my-profile-retry: /me load-failure Retry gated with !RendererInfo.IsInteractive plus aria-disabled; MyProfilePageTests now derive from ConsumerPortalBunitContext with Static/Server Retry rows
fixes.ledger-catalog-row: names CallerAppId sample-blazor-ui (gateway accesscontrol.yaml) against the ordinary model sidecar projects; the complete mTLS profile is stated as not exercised here; prepare-aspire-runtime-hosts.sh prerequisite added to it and to the live row
fixes.d1-residual: held_directory/made_directory docstrings and the D1 resolution state that an empty 0o700 same-user directory substituted between mkdir and reopen is still admitted

redproof-admin-organization.description: only the Organization details fieldset reverted to the baseline condition (_submitting || _detailsUnavailable); the razor restored byte for byte afterwards
redproof-admin-organization.observation: only the new organization Static row fails; the four existing person/create rows stay green, as the review found

redproof-my-profile-retry.description: MyProfilePage.razor still at baseline (ungated Retry), new rows retained
redproof-my-profile-retry.observation: the Static row fails (Retry enabled) and the Server row fails (no aria-disabled)

ordinary-catalog-caller-probe.description: temporary IntegrationTests probe (removed after the run): builds the ordinary AppHost model only, maps sidecar projects to app ids and lists each receiver ACL caller with no modeled project
ordinary-catalog-caller-probe.buildLog: not retained (probe build); the probe compiled cleanly with -warnaserror after one CA2007 fix

live-test-opt-in.result: unchanged outcome: finalize-package-catalog, Sequence contains no matching element; the record now carries startup.observerFailure (fixture.App unavailable, caught), runFailure null, exitSamplingResolutionMs 10 and an empty skippedLaunchers

notRun: the full lanes and e2e repeats (coordinator-owned after this follow-up)
localState: the prepared Release runtime cohort was refreshed for the opt-in run; the later AdminPortal/ConsumerPortal test builds rebuilt shared src projects, so it must be refreshed again before another live run
